messages:
Alice M: hey team, quick pulse check — we have a staging load test next Tue 02:00 UTC and I need to reserve ~8x A100 for a 3h window. can procurement confirm availability and ETA from the vendor? :eyes:
Ben K: do we need dedicated reserved capacity or can we cover with spot/standby for that window?
Alice M: ideally reserved so latency is stable for the smoke runs. if not, spot fallback is ok but we need a playbook.
Carla R: vendor said they can spare a short-term block but they want a PO confirmation. not fully firm yet, waiting on procurement to ack.
procurement-bot: PO status: pending. awaiting finance approval for one-off demo PO (ref #PO-8942). estimated vendor-confirm by EOD Mon if finance clears.
Ben K: if finance drags, we should pre-authorize a fallback: 6x A100 + 2x L40s to cover throughput. cheaper and quicker.
Dave L: I can pick up the terraform/alloc PR to spin a temporary reserved slice if procurement gives the go. ping me when PO is final and i'll merge + tag.
infra-bot: quota check: current org a100 quota (eu-west1): 32 used / 40 soft quota. requesting +8 will exceed soft quota; will need quota bump or temporary project carve.
Alice M: thanks — @Dave L can you open the PR now (draft) so procurement can see the terraform change? also add billing tag `staging-loadtest`.
Dave L: doing that now — draft PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/pulls/3124 (WIP)
Dave L: terraform snippet in the PR to claim slice:
```hcl
resource "redwood_gpu_pool" "staging_temp" {
  region = "eu-west1"
  model  = "a100"
  count  = 8
  tags   = ["staging-loadtest"]
  duration_hours = 3
}
```
Carla R: procurement note — vendor needs `billing_entity` on the PO (customer-facing). finance prefers `rw-staging` entity, will update if you add that to the PR.
Ben K: what's the fallthrough plan if vendor cancels <12h before window? auto-failover to spot in us-west with KV-cache warmup?
Alice M: yes — fallback plan:
- try vendor reserved first
- if confirmation not present by T-12h, trigger spot blend in us-west (6 A100 preemptible + 2 L40s)
- use regional routing in test harness to route to us-west fallback
Ben K: can someone add the routing flag in the test harness config? small patch: `fallback_region = "us-west1"`
Dave L: added the flag to the draft PR and a small script to pre-warm KV cache across regions. link in PR.
procurement-bot: finance update: flagged PO-8942 for expedited review, small chance of same-day approval. will post final status here.
Carla R: vendor ETA update: tentative hold until Tue 09:00 UTC (they're syncing logistics) — that's after our window. if finance cannot expedite, vendor will only confirm for Wed.
Alice M: ok that's risky. Dave — can you validate the cost delta for the spot fallback and confirm approval boundaries? (we need hold-authority to spend up to $2.5k for the/night window)
Dave L: i'll calc and paste numbers in the PR comments. preliminary: spot blend ~ $1.8k for 3h, reserved vendor rate ~ $2.2k but higher SLA.
Ben K: :thumbsup: if Dave posts numbers i'm good with auto-fallback under $2.5k.
Alice M: thanks. final asks:
- @procurement-bot keep us posted on PO-8942 by EOD Mon
- @Dave L merge terraform + routing when PO clears or if finance grants provisional approval
- @Carla R keep vendor on standby and check if they can move confirmation earlier
- @Ben K update test harness note with the fallback timeout (T-12h)
Carla R: will do vendor nudge now.
Dave L: i'll finish PR (add billing_entity, cost numbers, and script) — will mark it ready once procurement confirms.
procurement-bot: PO-8942 status: finance approved (expedited) at 2024-05-06T15:23Z. vendor notified.
Alice M: amazing, thanks all. i'll schedule the run and follow up in the run-book. :rocket:
